recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit as-is. Revisit only if Pharmacy later asks for different note semantics or cardinality; FHIR-5559 itself is already represented in current source.
issue_request: FHIR-5559 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Pharmacy request to consider adding a note element to MedicationPrescription, MedicationAdministration, MedicationStatement, and MedicationDispense, using a MedicationStatement free-text adherence note as the motivating example.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-5559 was found. The source history appears to carry the change through older pharmacy-resource evolution: history.html records note additions for MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, and MedicationRequest, and later source imports/reworks retain the note elements in active resource definitions.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription/MedicationOrder is now represented by MedicationRequest in the current build. source/fhir.ini lists MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement as active resources, and its version-map comments record MedicationPrescription becoming MedicationRequest and MedicationOrder mapping to MedicationRequest. No relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that changes this interpretation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current StructureDefinitions already include MedicationAdministration.note, MedicationDispense.note, MedicationRequest.note, and MedicationStatement.note as repeatable Annotation elements, satisfying the Jira request without adding redundant narrative.
